concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. New Lobs of Love app-icon exploration, using attached console-icon as primary style reference. Direction A: POCKET COURT. Preserve beautiful painted indigo and periwinkle shell, emerald court, amber buttons, peach edge lighting, dark navy outlines and broad gouache brushwork. Make device feel like an intentional pocket game console: squat square base, two chunky amber buttons, clearly hinged upright blue lid. Miniature real tennis court on horizontal base with clean white linework and taut small net. A single golden yellow tennis ball floats just above court in front of lid, smaller than in reference so court is readable. CRITICAL: ball is a conventional round tennis ball with a physically plausible continuous ivory seam joining two felt panels; visible curves smoothly wrap away around sphere. Seams have constant narrow width, never intersect, never branch, never meet in a pointed cusp; no heart or invented symbol. Clean 3/4 isometric perspective. Refine clarity and silhouette rather than adding detail. Full object entirely inside square frame with 12 percent margins; opaque deep ink-blue background. One finished illustrated app icon, no words, letters, emojis, motion swooshes, orbit trails, flowers, photoreal rendering or presentation board.

Use case: logo-brand. New Lobs of Love app icon exploration. Attached image is palette and painted-style reference only. Direction B: COURT CABINET. Invent a tiny squat tabletop arcade cabinet whose open recessed play chamber contains a real miniature emerald tennis court with white lines and a small net, like a little tennis world physically inside an arcade machine. Clearly different from reference laptop/clamshell: upright chunky cabinet with rounded indigo side walls, short blue overhanging canopy, open front, foreshortened court extending toward viewer, two amber square buttons on a short front lip. A single small ordinary golden yellow tennis ball hovering inside the chamber. Ball has simple narrow ivory curved tennis seam smoothly wrapping around its spherical surface, physically conventional two-panel tennis-ball construction, never intersecting or branching, no pointed joins or heart shapes. Preserve reference curious cobalt, violet, emerald, warm amber, peach rim light; hand-painted broad gouache shading, bold navy contour, illustrated game-prop character. Three-quarter isometric composition, squat iconic proportions, strong legible silhouette, only essential details. Entire object visible with safe margins on square opaque deep indigo background. No words, numbers, letters, emojis, orbit trails, photorealistic materials or collage. One polished icon concept.

Use case: logo-brand. One new illustrated Lobs of Love app-icon concept. Reference image supplies palette, painting style, tennis-console idea. Direction C: TENNIS JEWEL BOX. Push the compact form: a thick square indigo game cartridge case opened to about 105 degrees, almost a cube silhouette, low lid with luminous periwinkle inner panel, chunky sculpted corners, short brass hinge. In base is a miniature emerald tennis court with ivory court lines and a small net. Two small square amber controls set into front rim. Single large golden yellow tennis ball suspended above the net and partly overlapping top silhouette of the low lid. Ball is conventionally constructed from two curved felt panels with a narrow uniform-width ivory seam: smooth plausible wrapping curves, no intersections, branches, pinches, heart shapes, swirls or pointed ends. Do not stylize seam into a logo. Clear isometric three-quarter view; device is much more compact and square than reference, like a precious strange little pocket object. Hand-painted chunky cel shading, broad controlled gouache texture, confident navy outlines, violet shadows, peach warm edge highlights, rich blue/green/amber color relationships. Solid deep ink background, whole object with 12 percent clear margin, square app icon. No letters, text, emojis, trails, badges, tiny decorations, flowers, photorealism, presentation sheets. Make the silhouette bold enough for small scale.
